probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the__ one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not include NaOH__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that are not subjected to NaOH treatment__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent state__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of__ genotyping.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __their analyzed__ genotype.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and does not involve NaOH treatment__.
